script.title: AT THE TAILOR SHOP
script.story_hook: Shortening a pair of dress pants before Saturday.
script.intro_zh: 趕在星期六之前把褲長改短。
script.welcome_en: Hey everyone, welcome back! Today we're at a tailor shop, getting pants hemmed.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨各位，歡迎回來！今天我們來到修改店，把褲子改褲管。
script.outro: That's it for today! Listen once more and try along. See you next time.
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！再聽一遍，自己試試看。下次見。
script.practice_intro_en: Time to practice — repeat each line after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 練習時間到——跟著我，一句一句重複。
script.char_a_description: a slim young Black man in his early twenties with short twisted hair, wearing a light blue oxford shirt and a tan quilted jacket, nervously turning his trouser cuff over and over in his hands
script.char_b_description: a cheerful elderly Latina woman in her seventies with silver hair in a low bun, round glasses on a chain, a rust-colored cardigan stuck with pins, a soft tape around her neck, marking fabric with tailor's chalk
script.youtube_title: 【🧵👖改褲實戰英文】「加急多收八塊」怎麼說？超實用修改店句型，聽完就能開口｜✂️Pants Hemming English
script.youtube_title_en: “Rush Service for Eight Extra” — Getting Pants Hemmed at the Tailor
script.youtube_description:
褲子太長，卻不敢開口請人改？這段超真實的修改店對話幫你一次學會！跟著顧客在裁縫店報尺寸、試穿確認、問加急費用，還順便收腰圍。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Too shy to ask a tailor to fix your pants? This super-realistic tailor-shop conversation solves it in one listen. A customer gives measurements, tries on the pants, asks about rush fees, and even takes in the waist — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and speak up today.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🧵改褲子英文｜報尺寸・試穿確認・加急費用｜聽完就會改衣｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
出國後褲子太長，不知道怎麼請人改？
加急要多收錢，又該怎麼問？

這一集帶大家走進一間社區修改店，跟著顧客從報尺寸、試穿確認，到選加急服務、順便收腰圍，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
📏 報尺寸與試穿：例如「About two inches, I think.」、「Let's pin them first; try them on, okay?」。
⏰ 取件時間與加急：例如「When can I pick them up?」、「We can do rush service for eight extra.」。
🪡 追加修改：例如「Could you take in this waist?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完記得實戰一次，原來改條褲子可以這麼簡單！
script.thumbnail_action: holding out a pair of long dress pants

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need these pants hemmed, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ nid ðiːz pænts hɛmd pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我需要把這條褲子改褲管，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing. How short do you want them?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr θɪŋ haʊ ʃɔrt du ju wɑnt ðɛm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's pin them first; try them on, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts pɪn ðɛm fɜrst traɪ ðɛm ɑn oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我們先別上珠針，你再試穿一下，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No problem. Where should I stand?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here, please. Stand still for a sec.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt hɪr pliːz stænd stɪl fɚ ə sɛk/
dialogue.zh: 請站在這裡。先站著別動一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? Do they feel even?
dialogue.zh: 這樣可以嗎？兩邊看起來一樣長嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost — the left side needs a bit more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlˌmoʊst ðə lɛft saɪd nidz ə bɪt mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 差不多了——左邊還要再多收一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fine. When can I pick them up?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts faɪn wɛn kæn aɪ pɪk ðɛm ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係。我什麼時候可以來取？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Regular service takes three or four days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛɡjələr ˈsɜrvɪs teɪks θri ɔr fɔr deɪz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, I actually need them for Saturday.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ aɪ ˈæktʃuəli nid ðɛm fɚ ˈsætərˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，我其實星期六就要穿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can do rush service for eight extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn du rʌʃ ˈsɜrvɪs fɚ eɪt ɪkˈstrɑ/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以做加急，多收八塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That works. I'll take the rush option.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɜrks aɪl teɪk ðə rʌʃ ˈɑpʃən/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. Anything else you'd like fixed today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɛls ju d laɪk fɪkst təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好。今天還有別的地方想改嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Actually yes, could you take in this waist?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæktʃuəli jɛs kʊd ju teɪk ɪn ðɪs weɪst/
dialogue.zh: 其實有的，可以幫我把腰圍改小一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that's an easy one. I'll mark it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæts ən ˈizi wʌn aɪl mɑrk ɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，那個很好改。我現在就做記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, thank you so much for your help!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt θæŋk ju su mʌtʃ fɚ jɔr hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，非常謝謝你的幫忙！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pleasure. See you Saturday, then!
